summary.name: KinetAios
summary.one_liner: KinetAios is a local-first desktop AI agent dashboard that runs multiple AI engines (Direct V1–V5, Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek Harness) in one window.
use_cases: Running several AI coding agents side by side from one window
Keeping AI memory and preferences synced across devices via Git
Automating tasks with built-in tools and MCP servers
Routing requests to different AI engines automatically
Using AI assistants through Feishu or WeChat bots
Keeping API keys and chat history stored locally
summary.what_it_does: The page describes KinetAios as a dashboard that runs seven AI engines in one window, including Direct V1–V5 (an intent router, Legis, and Phylum), Claude Code, Codex, and DeepSeek Harness. It lists 30+ built-in tools, 21 plugins, and MCP integration. Cross-engine long-term memory is said to sync across devices through Git. It also mentions multi-agent teams and Feishu/WeChat bot support. Privacy claims on the page: API keys are stored in the OS keychain, history and memory are kept in local SQLite (FTS5), telemetry is none, and uploads are never sent. It is built with Electron and TypeScript.
notable: Seven AI engines in one window, including Claude Code, Codex and DeepSeek Harness
Cross-engine long-term memory synced across devices with Git
Local-only data: API keys in OS keychain, history and memory in local SQLite, no telemetry or uploads
caveats: Page text is mostly marketing and a partly garbled sample chat; pricing and licensing details are not stated on the page
Listing describes the project as open source, but the page text itself does not state a license
Feature list is self-reported and not independently verified
